name: Kisvejke (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner with two horizontal bands of green and yellow at the bottom, charged near the top with the municipal arms of Kisvejke (a blue and yellow shield with a horseman and a bunch of grapes) above a yellow scroll inscribed KISVEJKE.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
